scope: Jenkins canonical L1/L2 only. No L3 investigation or grade change. No absent-native-oracle ceiling is retained.

candidates.name: Jenkins Declarative Converter and ModelAST
candidates.result: all 23 canonical L1/L2 inputs accepted with 50 pinned plugins and three declaration-only tool slots; 753 model nodes, 747 positioned. A complete dialect declaration/pair comparator is unbuilt; these are not 753 dialect definitions or an L2 recall claim.

candidates.name: Jenkins declarative linter and toJson endpoint
candidates.result: validate attests syntax/model acceptance; toJson exposes the owner model but does not serialize sourceLocation. Direct ModelAST access is the measured positioned route.

candidates.name: Groovy AST plus existing JenkinsfileAstDump
candidates.result: compiler reports Groovy syntax; the custom walk assigns Jenkins DSL meanings and pair ownership, so current 163/163 definitions and 133/133 pairs remain C

candidates.name: gvy SCIP and LSIF exporter
candidates.result: real SCIP/LSIF writers exist, correcting the no-producer premise. UnifiedIndexer at this pin visits only classes and methods, explicitly leaves body visitation unimplemented, and supplies no Pipeline stage/section/step population. Its separate Jenkins diagnostics are not a SCIP DSL oracle.

candidates.name: Groovy Language Server
candidates.result: definition, references and documentSymbol are available for Groovy. Independent non-SCIP analysis remains C under P-T1 and cannot by itself raise the current tier cap.

candidates.name: jenkinsfilelint
candidates.result: owner-maintained wrapper of Jenkins validate; no positioned symbol/pair enumeration. Local mode requires Docker/Podman, prohibited here; the underlying owner API was run without containers.

candidates.name: jenkinsfile-lint (jflint)
candidates.result: wraps official Jenkinsfile Runner in Docker. That wrapper is unavailable on this no-Docker machine; it is not evidence that native Jenkins is unavailable.

candidates.name: Jenkinsfile Runner lint
candidates.result: existing declarative lint command avoids pipeline execution but returns validation, not complete positioned definitions/local pairs. A guessed 1.0-beta-38 tag was absent; the actual source commit is pinned instead.

candidates.name: Jenkins Workflow API FlowGraphWalker
candidates.status: API audited; no runtime trace run
candidates.result: enumerates nodes produced by an execution; does not enumerate every unexecuted branch or all syntax-only references. Executing subjects would run their build steps and is outside this parse-only diagnostic.

candidates.name: JenkinsPipelineUnit
candidates.result: test-side mocks and exercised-call recording do not constitute the complete native written-pair population; no mocked trace is promoted to tier A

candidates.name: Groovy ProxyMetaClass and Interceptor
candidates.result: records exercised Groovy calls, while supplying Jenkins step behavior requires a separate runtime or mocks; insufficient alone for full static pair recall

candidates.name: universal-ctags
candidates.result: the documented Groovy fallback forces the Java parser. It does not provide the owner Pipeline DSL model or stage/section semantics; no forced-Java tags were treated as Jenkins definitions.
